resources.string: Connected address: %1$s\nTo move to a new address of the same Kelo server, type the new https address. Your chats and keys stay as they are, and you don\'t need to connect again.
That doesn\'t look like an https address. Type it like https://kelo.example.com.
Couldn\'t reach that address. Check it and your connection, then try again.
That address belongs to a different server, so nothing was changed. To connect to another server, log out and connect it from the start.
This phone already uses that address.
